author: Joltz_
body:
The X Factor: Avicus!


Are you a singer? Can you sing good? Are you in for a prize? Do you wanna have fun? Well  Me and my partner, Jozzeh, Present the X Factor!



How it works?

Post below your Auditions and we will pick the top 10 auditions to participate in our Showdowns. Every week there will be an eliminated contestant who receives the least amount of votes.  When the top 3 are decided we go into the finale. 3rd and 2nd Getting a mystery prize. 

What can I win?

For the Participants. Jozzmcozz's Love
3rd and 2nd- To be released
Winner- An Avicus personalized T-Shirt

How do I audition?

Follow this template
Skype:
Youtube Username:
Audition tape:
